description.before: Colt launched commercial SCION connectivity across Europe, North America and Asia after a two-year proof of concept with Anapaya. The service lets enterprises specify and audit the paths their network traffic takes.
description.after:
Colt launched a fully managed SCION networking service across Europe, North America and Asia using Zurich-based Anapaya's technology.
Commercial availability follows a two-year proof of concept, including testing with financial-sector organisations.
The service lets customers define, audit and enforce the paths their traffic takes, giving them control over routing for sensitive or regulated communications.

Colt offers two configurations: SCION private connects customers to existing private ecosystems and extranets, while SCION Global provides a WAN for an organisation's backbone network.
The release describes security and resilience benefits but provides no quantified performance benchmark or service-availability measurements.

description.before: DAPEVO combines conventional frames with event-camera measurements to estimate motion when images become sparse or unreliable. In the UZH-FPV benchmark, keeping only one in six frames increased mean trajectory error from 1.00 to 1.36 metres. The work is available as a research preprint.
description.after:
UZH researchers developed DAPEVO to estimate camera motion from conventional images and asynchronous event-camera measurements.
It tracks corresponding patches in both inputs separately, then uses a learned gate to combine their evidence before refining the motion estimate.
Event-only observations allow tracking to continue between sparse or unavailable conventional frames.

On the UZH-FPV benchmark, retaining only one in six conventional frames increased DAPEVO's mean absolute trajectory error from 1.00 to 1.36 metres.
In the same experiment, errors for the DPVO and RAMP-VO comparison methods rose by factors of 3.7 and 3.1 respectively.
These are reported benchmark results from a research preprint, not evidence of a deployed navigation system or uninterrupted tracking under all camera failures.
